Place & perspective

Beyond the skyline, a sense of place.

Dubai’s architectural variety gives each setting a different visual language. For a photography project, the question is not simply how to show the city, but how to communicate the particular space, its materials and the experience it offers. The selected galleries keep that discussion grounded in actual work.

01

Hotel photography in Dubai

25 Hours Dubai, Raffles The Palm, Rixos The Palm, Rixos JBR and Th8 Palm Dubai are the five Dubai projects featured in this collection. Their galleries are useful references when discussing hotel photography in Dubai. Compare the different settings and identify the spaces, details and atmosphere that should define your own photographic story.

02

Interior and architectural photography

A coherent interior photography collection can move from an overall view to the details that make a room recognisable. Consider the relationship between light, materials and proportions, and explain where the final photographs will appear. The right balance of wide views and closer frames starts with the intended use.

03

Preparing a Dubai photography brief

Share your property or company name, exact site, preferred dates and the areas that need to be photographed. Include reference images and the required formats. Travel and production details are discussed before the project is confirmed. The selected Dubai galleries provide references for the creative conversation.

Planning the shoot

Which Dubai photography projects can I view?

The selected galleries feature 25 Hours Dubai, Raffles The Palm, Rixos The Palm, Rixos JBR and Th8 Palm Dubai. Each project links to its published photo selection.

What information helps with a Dubai project enquiry?

Share the exact location, priority spaces, preferred timing, intended image uses and the person coordinating access. Include film requirements too if they are part of the brief.
